Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Vil du også være på den grønne gren?
description:
Er du uddannet pædagog, kan levere varmt nærvær i børnehøjde og være fagligt reflekterende i dit arbejde, er det dig vi leder efter

Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  14. august 2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

title: Senior Tender Manager – Rig & Offshore Marine; DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you eager to combine your technical skills with your commercial mindset? Do you thrive on leading complex tender processes, creating structure across teams, and driving strategic initiatives in a dynamic and international company? Then this great opportunity might be the right match for you!

Your position 

In our Rig & Offshore Marine division, we are looking for a structured and skilled leading Senior Tender Manager who can create alignment across teams and ensure successful execution of strategic tender activities. This position offers a wide range of exciting challenges within yard stays, engineering and modification projects on drilling rigs and special vessels worldwide.

You will be part of the Rig & Offshore Marine department, consisting of 175 colleagues working locally and globally on projects across the division, reporting to Vice President, Espen Thomassen.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ in Esbjerg, Denmark. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel up to 50 days per year.

Your tasks and responsibilities

You will be responsible for developing and driving the global tender function within Rig & Offshore Marine while ensuring successful execution of strategic bids. In the role, it is important to create alignment across teams, share knowledge and continuously improve the way we work with tenders globally.

You will be overall responsible for the tender process and have leadership of the tender team while actively participating in selected tenders and business-critical opportunities.

Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:
  • Owning and developing the global tender process across Rig & Offshore Marine.
  • Leading and coordinating the tender team across Denmark and Norway.
  • Acting as a hands-on lead for the global tender function.
  • Leading and coordinating bid teams across regions.
  • Driving strategic tenders and commercial opportunities.
  • Ensuring alignment of commercial, technical and contractual matters.
  • Supporting client engagement and business development.

Your qualifications and skills

You enjoy interacting with people at all levels and are passionate about enabling teams to succeed together. You are a natural leader with a structured approach and a strong ability to create overview in complex processes. You thrive in a role where you combine operational execution with strategic leadership.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • Relevant education within Engineering, Marine Engineering, Service Engineering or similar.
  • Significant experience within tender management, bid management or related commercial roles.
  • Experience leading teams or coordinating functions across locations.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with large-scale commercial and technical tenders.
  • Knowledge of contracts and commercial negotiations.
  • A structured and proactive approach combined with strong communication skills.
  • Comfortable with written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

title: Project & Business Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

title: Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
Als **Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d)** verbindest du hands-on Engineering mit technischer Führung und prägst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Databricks-basierten Datenökosystems. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Architekt:innen, Product Ownern und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst technische Entscheidungen, die sowohl kurzfristige Anforderungen als auch langfristige strategische Ziele unterstützen. Du verstehst, wie die Arbeit des Engineering-Teams zu konkreten Geschäftsergebnissen beiträgt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Du schreibst Code, definierst Standards und unterstützt sowie coachst andere Engineers. Gleichzeitig bist du die zentrale technische Eskalationsstelle für komplexe Herausforderungen.

Zu deinen Kernaufgaben gehören:

- Die Leitung von Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Data-Lösungen im Enterprise-Maßstab auf Databricks
- Die Konzeption und Implementierung skalierbarer Data-Ingestion-Frameworks für Batch- und Streaming-Workloads
- Die Verantwortung für Databricks Asset Bundles / Declarative Automation Bundles, Deployment-Pipelines und Multi-Environment-Konfigurationen
- Die Steuerung von Data-Governance-Initiativen über Unity Catalog, inklusive Access Management, Storage Credentials und Metadatenverwaltung
- Die Definition und Pflege von Engineering-Standards wie Coding Practices, Code Reviews, Dokumentation und Data-Quality-Frameworks
- Das Coaching anderer Data Engineers sowie die Übernahme der technischen Eskalation bei komplexen Herausforderungen

Profil

Du bist eine **hands-on technische Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit umfassender Databricks-Erfahrung. Du denkst über die unmittelbare Aufgabe hinaus, hast die gesamte Plattform im Blick und triffst Architekturentscheidungen mit Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Datenstrategie. Du verstehst die Verbindung zwischen Engineering-Output und Business-Impact und findest die Balance zwischen schneller Lieferung und nachhaltiger Governance.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du:

- Umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit produktionsreifen Databricks-Lösungen hast
- Sehr sicher in Python, PySpark und SQL bist – inklusive komplexer Transformationen, Performanceoptimierung und Query-Design
- Erfahrung im Design von Databricks Asset Bundles und im Deployment über mehrere Umgebungen hinweg mitbringst
- Fundiertes Wissen über Unity Catalog, Data Governance, Access Control und Best Practices im Datenmanagement besitzt
- CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Technologien aufgebaut und betrieben hast
- Architekturentscheidungen und technische Trade-offs klar und verständlich kommunizieren kannst – sowohl technisch als auch nicht-technisch - auf Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil sind:

- Erfahrung mit Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Genie oder Semantic Layer Design
- Kenntnisse im Azure Identity- und Secrets-Management, z. B. Entra ID, OIDC Federation und Azure Key Vault
- Erfahrung darin, GDPR- und Vertraulichkeitsanforderungen in Data-Engineering-Lösungen zu integrieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil einer ambitionierten und kollaborativen Organisation, in der Daten eine immer wichtigere Rolle für Innovation und geschäftlichen Mehrwert spielen. Du erhältst die Chance, unsere moderne Datenplattform aktiv mitzugestalten und an strategischen Initiativen im gesamten Unternehmen mitzuwirken.

Wir bieten dir ein flexibles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, zum Wissensaustausch und zum beruflichen Wachstum. Dich erwartet eine Kultur, die von Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung geprägt ist.

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

title: Filstedvejens Skoles specialafdeling søger to nye kolleger. En pædagog og en pædagogisk assistent.
description:
Vi sender to skønne kollegaer på pension og sørger derfor en pædagog til en 32 timers stilling pr. 1. oktober samt en pædagogmedhjælper/assistent til en 28 timers stilling pr. 1. november. Begge stillinger er til vores fantastisk specialafdeling fyldt med dygtige medarbejdere og 26 skønne elever.

Vi søger dig, der er engageret og faglig stærk og som vil være med til at skabe den bedste skole- og Dusdag for vores elever i specialafdelingen. Vi søger en person med et roligt nervesystem og som er robust og mødestabil. En som besidder en god portion empati og humor, og som brænder for at udvikle sit fag sammen med kommende kolleger, og som trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med fokus på faglighed og trivsel.

Vi er et specialtilbud for elever med neuromassive indlæringsvanskeligheder. Elevgruppen er kendetegnet ved en generelt forsinket udvikling i forhold til kognitive, sproglige, motoriske og sociale kompetencer. Flere elever har diagnoser relateret til udviklingshæmning, hjerneskade, syndromer eller neuropsykiatriske vanskeligheder, og nogle har desuden fysiske handicaps. Eleverne har behov for omfattende støtte til at udvikle basale færdigheder og til at indgå i sociale fællesskaber.

Fælles for eleverne er, at de har et udviklingspotentiale, som kan understøttes gennem en målrettet, struktureret og relationsbåret indsats, hvor undervisningen og aktiviteterne i skole og dus tilpasses den enkelte elevs forudsætninger. 

Vi prioriterer vores forældresamarbejde og teamsamarbejde højt samt samarbejdet med vores eksterne samarbejdspartnere i kommunen. Opgaverne i stillingen kan variere alt efter, hvilke kompetencer du bringer med. Vores elever har et behov for støtte, guidning og kontakt til det pædagogiske personale, hvorfor det er yderst vigtigt, at du brænder for lige netop vores tilbud.   

Filstedvejens Skole er:

  • En skole hvor vi lykkes i fællesskab, og hvor der er højt til loftet
  • En velfungerende skole med ca. 580 glade og lærelystne elever
  • Fyldt med en dygtig og engageret medarbejderstab på 120 lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, teknisk-administrativt personale og rengøringspersonale 
  • To- og tre sporet fra 0.-9.klasse i almen samt specialafdelingen 
  • Heldig at have både en normal- og special-DUS samt DUS-2 for elever fra 4.-6. klasse 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En skole og DUS hvor du vil blive mødt i et samarbejdende fællesskab.
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på hverdagen.
  • En attraktiv arbejdsplads med mange faglige muligheder.
  • En skole, hvor vi tager hånd om hinanden

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, hvis du søger stillingen som pædagog
  • Har stor lyst til at være en del af både skole og DUS
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og omsorgsfuld i arbejdet med børnene.
  • Er stærk i forældresamarbejdet
  • Er en teamplayer
  • Har gode samarbejds- og relationskompetencer.
  • Er aktiv med børnene i form af aktiviteter, der er tilpasset deres behov
  • Har erfaring indenfor specialområdet
  • Gerne musiske og kreative kompetencer 
  • Lade humør, seriøsitet og ansvarlighed gå ”hånd-i-hånd” 
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat

Skulle du have lyst til at blive en del af ovenstående, og du ønsker at høre mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Maria Vesterholm 25209449, mail: mbv-skole@aalborg.dk. Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist 23. august, og vi forventer at afholde samtaler 27. august. 

Påfør venligst overskrift på din ansøgning, hvilken stilling du søger. 

Du kan finde mere information på vores hjemmeside www.filstedvejensskole.dk samt på skolens facebookside: www.facebook.com/filstedvejens

title: Vi søger en ny kollega til vores lille historiske børnehave midt i Helsingør
description:
Vi søger en pædagogiskmedhjælper til vores lille historiske børnehave Børneasylet midt i Helsingør.

Kunne du tænke dig at være en del af en arbejdsplads med 190 års historie, hvor alle medarbejdere har reel indflydelse på hverdagen? Et sted fyldt med sjæl, historie og eventyr? Vil du arbejde i en lille børnehave med kun 27 børn, hvor relationer, nærvær og pædagogisk refleksion står i centrum, hvor udelivet vægtes højt, og hvor børn går med bare tær om sommeren?

Omme bag den grønne port i Helsingørs travle gågade ligger en privat børnehave med fem medarbejder, herunder én leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med en hyggelig legeplads med bålplads og vildtvoksende gemmesteder.

Hos os er det nære børneliv i fokus. Vi arbejder ud fra det nye børnesyn med blik for barnets perspektiv, ressourcer og deltagelsesmuligheder i fællesskabet. Legen har stor værdi i vores hverdag, og vi vægter udeliv, relationer og pædagogisk refleksion højt.

 

Er du stadig nysgerrig?

 

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Helsingør Børneasylet.

Stillingen søges med opstart snarest.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • arbejder ud fra barnets perspektiv og det nye børnesyn

  • kan understøtte og deltage aktivt i børns leg

  • er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og relationsstærk

  • vil være med til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn

  • kommunikere anerkendende og professionelt – både med børn, forældre og kollegaer

  • værdsætter et tæt og tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde

  • kan indgå i løbende refleksion og evaluering af det pædagogiske arbejde

  • har lyst til at bidrage til et fællesskab, hvor alle hjælpe hinanden

  • trives i et lille hus med tæt samarbejde

 

Vi står et sted, hvor vi ønsker at udvikle vores fælles kultur og samarbejde endnu mere, og vi søger derfor en kollega, der har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til fællesskabet og den pædagogiske udvikling.

Hos os får du:

  • et fagligt engageret og støttende team

  • stor indflydelse på hverdagen og pædagogikken

  • mulighed for at sætte et meningsfyldt præg på børnenes hverdag

  • en arbejdsplads med historie, charme og personlighed

title: Postdoc Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more postdoc positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a two-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the appointment, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center’s project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect

We expect that you hold a PhD degree or expect to be awarded one before the start date, within engineering, robotics, computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Project & Business Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:
  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.
