title: Business Analyst Data (F/H) h/f
description:
Description de l'entreprise
Le Groupe BPCE, avec son modèle de banque coopérative universelle, représenté par 9 millions de sociétaires, est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 105 000 collaborateurs, il est au service de 30 millions de clients dans le monde, particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, investisseurs et collectivités locales. Il est présent dans la banque de proximité et l'assurance en France avec ses deux grands réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d'Epargne ainsi que la Banque Palatine. Chez BPCE Equipment Solutions, nous sommes spécialisés en financement des ventes et des équipements professionnels aux entreprises et nous sommes leader en Europe et n°2 mondial sur notre marché. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a digital and customer-centric organization, committed to deliver an excellent experience to vendors partners and clients across countries. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 22 personnes en tant que Business Analyst Senior.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions de :Recueillir les besoins auprès des Métiers, spécifications et validation des développements de la plateforme Data & Reporting réalisés dans l'équipe Accompagner les entités de la BU sur les évolutions de la plateforme Data et de la filière DataSupporter l'équipe dans les activités de Data Management, notamment le pilotage des usages DataContribuer aux pratiques agiles de l'équipe (slicing, priorisation par la valeur.) et accompagner le métier dans la transformation agileVous aurez l'occasion de partager de votre expérience au sein d'un environnement multiculturel (collaborateurs à Bangalore) et très en lien avec les Métiers et leurs problématiques. Un processus de recrutement efficace : une fois votre CV présélectionné, préparez-vous à un entretien RH avec un Responsable Recrutement, suivi de deux entretiens métiers maximum. Un groupe engagé dans les enjeux sociétaux et environnementauxEn intégrant le Groupe BPCE, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail hybride et favorisant le collaboratif.En tant qu'employeur responsable et engagé à construire un environnement de travail inclusif, nous offrons les mêmes opportunités aux talents de tous horizons, indépendamment de votre âge, origine, orientation sexuelle, handicap.Vous intégrerez un environnement international, au sein d'une communauté d'experts qui place l'excellence, l'impact et l'action collective au cœur de tout ce qu'elle entreprend.
Profil et compétences requises
Vous possédez une expérience d'au-moins 5 ans dans ce rôle, dans le domaine bancaire et autour des process métier lié au pilotage d'activité commerciale, risque et finance, idéalement dans le leasing.
Les compétences attendues sont :
- Maîtrise des environnements de type Datawarehouse et du requêtage SQL
- Maîtrise des pratiques agiles
- Capacité à coordonner des intervenants dans un contexte international
- Capacité à réaliser les tâches opérationnelles pour l'avancement du projet
- Anglais opérationnel

Une expérience de développement off-shore serait un plus.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Welcome to HARALD PIHL – where metals meet people, and curiosity meets craftsmanship.

We're a family-owned company with over 110 years of history, but our mindset is anything but old-fashioned. Here, professionalism goes hand in hand with warmth, teamwork and a healthy dose of positive energy.

We believe in being curious, solution-oriented and honest in everything we do – and we're proud of the culture we build together, across borders, roles and locations.

If you enjoy taking responsibility, making things better than they were yesterday, and being part of a company that truly cares about both results and people, you might feel right at home with us.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join HARALD PIHL GmbH and help us continue growing our business in Germany.

This position can be based either from our office in Krefeld or remotely. We are particularly interested in candidates located in Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria or surrounding regions.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining customer relationships within the market for titanium, nickel-based alloys and other specialty metals. You will manage the entire sales process, from identifying opportunities and preparing quotations to negotiating agreements and securing long-term customer partnerships.

You will work closely with customers in industries such as Aerospace, Defence, Medical, Energy and Advanced Manufacturing, helping them find the right material solutions for their applications.

The role combines relationship-building, technical sales and business development, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently while being part of an international and highly specialized organization.

Your mission is to strengthen our market position, create new business opportunities and deliver outstanding service to both new and existing customers.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities will include, among others:

    Managing and developing customer relationships within your sales region
    Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding our customer base
    Preparing quotations, following up on opportunities, and negotiating prices and commercial agreements
    Advising customers on materials, applications, and suitable product solutions
    Conducting customer visits and representing HARALD PIHL at meetings and industry events
    Managing customer projects from enquiry through order placement
    Working closely with internal teams to ensure excellent customer service and delivery performance
    Monitoring market developments, trends, and competitor activities
    Maintaining customer information and activities in CRM and ERP systems
    Supporting the development of sales strategies and business plans
    Contributing to continuous improvements and growth initiatives across the business

As our business continues to grow, the role may evolve with additional responsibilities and development opportunities over time.

Who we're looking for

Required experience & knowledge

    Several years of B2B sales experience within metals, steel, specialty alloys, engineering materials or related technical industries
    Proven experience developing customer relationships and driving commercial growth
    Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills
    Experience managing the full sales cycle
    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office 365
    Experience working with CRM and ERP systems
    Fluent German and English, written and spoken
    Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly within the region

Nice to have

    Experience within titanium, nickel-based alloys or specialty metals
    An existing network within relevant industrial sectors
    Commercial education or degree in business, engineering or a related field
    Experience with Monitor ERP
    Experience working with customers in Aerospace, Defence, Medical or Energy industries

Personal competencies

We believe how you work is just as important as what you know. For this role, we value that you are:

    Relationship-oriented – you naturally build trust and enjoy creating long-term business relationships
    Solution-oriented – you focus on finding practical and commercially viable solutions for customers
    Structured – you organize your work effectively, follow through on commitments and maintain a high level of quality
    Cooperative – you enjoy working with colleagues, customers, and partners to achieve shared goals

What it's like to work with us

At HARALD PIHL, you'll join a company where people genuinely enjoy working together.

We combine the agility of a local organization with the opportunities of an international business. You'll have significant freedom and responsibility in your role, while also benefiting from the support of experienced colleagues and a strong team culture.

We offer a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where ideas are welcomed, initiatives are encouraged and long-term relationships matter. Most importantly, you'll become part of a company with deep specialist expertise, a strong market position and a long-standing reputation as a trusted partner to customers around the world. If you're looking for a role where your expertise can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Für unseren Kunden, ein Unternehmen im Enterprise-Umfeld in der DACH-Region, suchen wir einen Platform Engineer, der mit seiner Expertise in AWS, Kubernetes und Terraform glänzt. Hier geht es nicht darum, nur Tickets abzuarbeiten, sondern aktiv die Plattform weiterzuentwickeln und zu optimieren. Du hast die Chance, maßgeblich Einfluss auf die technologische Ausrichtung zu nehmen und eine Schlüsselrolle in der Transformation zu spielen.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf die Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit der Systeme. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das stets nach den besten Lösungen sucht und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung lebt. Werde zum Vordenker und treibe innovative Projekte voran, die echte Mehrwerte schaffen.

Konkrete Beispiele deiner Aufgaben sind die Konzeption und Implementierung neuer AWS-Services, die Optimierung bestehender Kubernetes-Cluster oder die Entwicklung von Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen mit Terraform. Du arbeitest eng mit den Entwicklungsteams zusammen, um eine reibungslose Bereitstellung und den Betrieb von Anwendungen sicherzustellen. Deine Expertise ist gefragt!

Klingt das nach der Herausforderung, die du suchst? Dann melde dich bei uns und lass uns gemeinsam herausfinden, wie du unser Team bereichern kannst. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
Anforderungsprofil

Du bist bereit, deine Expertise einzusetzen und die technologische Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten? Für unseren Kunden im Enterprise-Umfeld suchen wir einen Senior DevOps Engineer, der nicht nur Anforderungen erfüllt, sondern auch eigene Ideen einbringt und Innovationen vorantreibt. Wenn du dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlst und deine Fähigkeiten in AWS, Kubernetes und Terraform täglich unter Beweis stellen möchtest, dann bist du hier genau richtig.

- Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit AWS-Diensten mit, um Cloud-Infrastrukturen zu entwerfen, zu implementieren und zu optimieren. Das beinhaltet das Management von EC2-Instanzen, S3-Buckets, RDS-Datenbanken und vielem mehr.
- Du bist ein Experte in der Arbeit mit Kubernetes, um containerisierte Anwendungen zu orchestrieren und zu skalieren. Du wirst Pods, Deployments und Services konfigurieren und sicherstellen, dass unsere Anwendungen reibungslos laufen.
- Du beherrschst Terraform aus dem Effeff, um Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu pflegen. So stellst du sicher, dass unsere Infrastruktur konsistent und reproduzierbar ist.
- Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierst gerne Deployment-Prozesse, um die Entwicklungszyklen zu beschleunigen und Fehler zu minimieren.
- Du bist ein Teamplayer und kommunizierst offen und proaktiv mit Entwicklungs- und Betriebsteams, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen und technische Herausforderungen zu meistern.

Wenn du dich in diesen Anforderungen wiederfindest und bereit bist, die Plattform unseres Kunden auf das nächste Level zu heben, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. - Attraktives Urlaubskontingent

title: Einzelwohnen – Berlin-Wilmersdorf – Sozialpädagogin (m/w/d) (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
employer: biac Personalservice GmbH NL Medizin/ Soziales
description:
Die Behindertenhilfe ist ein Feld mit sehr unterschiedlichen Bereichen: In einer Wohnform bist du nah an Routinen und Gemeinschaft, im betreuten Einzelwohnen stärker an individueller Begleitung, in werkstattnahen Kontexten oft an Tagesstruktur und Übergängen. Welcher Alltag dich konkret erwartet, beschreiben wir hier früh und klar.
Pädagogische Arbeit gelingt am besten, wenn Haltung, Teamstruktur und Organisation zusammenpassen – darauf achten wir im Vorfeld. Wir planen so, dass Einsätze fachlich sinnvoll bleiben und gleichzeitig zu deinem Alltag passen.
Du bringst pädagogische Kompetenz mit – hier siehst du, wo und wie sie gefragt ist:

DIESE SCHWERPUNKTE GEHÖREN IN WERKSTATT, WOHNEN UND ALLTAGSPRAKTISCHER BEGLEITUNG ZU DEINEM PROFIL:

• Mit einem klaren Blick für Rechte, Wünsche und Möglichkeiten begleitest du Prozesse so, dass soziale Teilhabe nicht nur organisiert, sondern konkret erlebbar wird.
• Im Wohnheim oder im Betreuten Einzelwohnen begleitest du Menschen alltagsnah und unterstützt dabei einen gut strukturierten Wohnalltag.
• Du beobachtest Situationen, Entwicklungen und wichtige Hinweise aufmerksam und dokumentierst sie verlässlich und nachvollziehbar.
• Neben dem direkten Kontakt trägst du auch die organisatorische Struktur des Alltags mit.

DEINE VORTEILE FÜR EINSÄTZE IM BETREUTEN EINZELWOHNEN:

• Urlaub fair abgestimmt: Deine Urlaubswünsche sprechen wir frühzeitig mit dir ab, damit freie Zeit, Team und Alltag verlässlich zusammenpassen.
• Urlaub mit klarer Abstimmung: Deine bis 30 Urlaubstage werden so geplant, dass fordernde Einsätze und persönliche Regeneration zusammenpassen.
• Finanziell stabil in verantwortungsvoller pädagogischer Arbeit: ab 20 €/Std. geben dir eine verlässliche Grundlage für deinen Einsatzalltag.
• Über die Grundvergütung hinaus gedacht: Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld stärken den Rahmen für deine Arbeit als pädagogische Fachkraft.
• Auch Randzeiten werden anerkannt: Für Wochenend-, Spät- oder Feiertagseinsätze erhältst du Extras, die zu deiner Fachkraftrolle passen.

DAS IST WICHTIG, DAMIT DER EINSATZ GUT ZU DIR PASST:

• Mit fachlicher Klarheit und kooperativer Haltung unterstützt du eine gut abgestimmte Begleitung im Alltag.
• Für diesen Einsatz wünschen wir uns einen sozialpädagogischen Hochschulabschluss, mit dem du Menschen, Familien oder Netzwerke professionell begleiten kannst.
• Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch sicher genug, damit Abstimmungen, Dokumentation und Alltagssituationen zuverlässig gelingen.
• Du nutzt Rückmeldungen, klärst offene Punkte früh und stärkst damit die Zusammenarbeit im Einsatz.

Im betreuten Einzelwohnen machen Selbstständigkeit, Beziehung und klare Absprachen oft den Unterschied. Genau darüber sprechen wir zuerst mit dir. So klären wir, ob Wege, Begleitungsauftrag und Teamrückbindung zu deiner Arbeitsweise passen.

WICHTIGE INFOS ZU ASSISTENZ UND BEGLEITUNG:

Bereichswahl Behindertenhilfe
Ob Wohnen, Werkstatt oder ein assistenznaher Alltag besser zu dir passt, berücksichtigen wir direkt in der Planung.
Urlaub
Vor einem Einsatz klären wir transparent, welcher Urlaubsanspruch gilt und wie Urlaub planbar bleibt.
Zusammenarbeit Behindertenhilfe
Klare Absprachen, passende Teamstrukturen und ein vorbereiteter Rahmen sind uns besonders wichtig.
Fachliche Schwerpunkte
Fachliche Schwerpunkte und sichere Bereiche sollen sich in den Vorschlägen klar wiederfinden.

title: ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) to lead the development of automotive-grade integrated circuits (ICs). This role is critical in managing cross-functional R&D teams to deliver high-quality ASICs that meet stringent automotive standards such as ISO 26262 and AEC-Q100.

In addition to project leadership, the role includes a responsibility for shaping and improving the ASIC development process, ensuring alignment with internal methodologies (PLC/MLC) and continuous enhancement of development efficiency and quality. The ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) will oversee planning, execution and delivery of IC development projects, ensuring alignment with cost, schedule and quality targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Coordination

- Managing an IC R&D project team to define, plan, realize and deliver agreed work products in accordance with automotive quality and safety standards
- Leading cross-functional teams including requirements engineering, architecture, design, verification, IP integration and tool support
- Convening and moderating regular and milestone-based R&D project meetings

Planning & Execution

- Developing detailed R&D project plans and providing inputs to the overall program management
- Managing implementation of project plan contents, ensuring timely and budget-compliant execution
- Providing budget requirements including effort estimation, tools, licenses and hardware
- Issuing work orders to specialist departments and ensuring alignment with project goals

Monitoring & Reporting

- Reporting development progress and status of the ASIC project to the Program Manager
- Monitoring and controlling all R&D project processes, ensuring adherence to schedule, budget and automotive compliance
- Providing project team members with necessary plans, updates and technical documentation
- Applying quality assurance practices including lessons-learned, peer reviews and risk assessments

Change & Risk Management

- Applying configuration and change management processes rigorously
- Participating in Change Control Board (CCB) meetings and managing R&D-related changes according to defined processes
- Supporting component cost estimation and strategic decision-making
- Ensuring project objectives are met in terms of budget, schedule and technical/quality targets

Process Improvement & Governance

- Supporting definition, maintenance and continuous improvement of the ASIC Development Process (e.g. COT / Turn-Key flows)
- Ensuring alignment of project execution with defined process phases, milestones and maturity levels (PLC/MLC)
- Supporting standardization of work products, templates and review criteria across projects
- Contributing to milestone review definitions and ensuring compliance with process requirements
- Driving lessons learned and feedback into process improvements
- Supporting process compliance with automotive standards such as ISO 26262

Key Success Factors

- Successful delivery of ASIC projects on time, budget and quality
- High level of cross-functional team alignment and execution efficiency
- Compliance with automotive standards and internal processes
- Continuous improvement of development processes and project performance

Qualifications

- Academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or comparable qualifiaction
- Long-term experience in ASIC/IC development and technical project management, preferably in the automotive domain
- Experience with functional safety and FTA, FMEA, FMEDA processes
- Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Confluence)
- Experience with process modelling tools (e.g., ARMS Stages, Confluence)
- Strong background in IC design methodology, analog circuit design and EDA tools
- Deep expertise in CMOS (analog, digital, RF) and BCD technologies
- Proven track record in automotive product development and IC design
- Strong understanding of automotive IC development lifecycle, including ISO 26262 and PPAP
- Familiarity with automotive-grade reliability and qualification standards (e.g., AEC-Q100)
- Knowledge of automotive mission profiles and environmental stress testing
- Business fluent German and English language skills (written and spoken)
- Excellent communication, leadership and organizational skills
- Ability to manage distributed teams across global locations
- Strong communication skills and customer focus

title: Experienced ASIC Analog Design Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. That’s why we foster a culture where you own every step of the way.
Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an Experienced ASIC Analog Design Engineer (m/f/d), you will contribute to the development of analog and mixed-signal high-voltage integrated circuits for automotive applications, such as sensor interfaces and smart power devices. You will take ownership of complex transistor-level analog designs, support analog-on-top and chip-level integration, break down requirements into block-level design targets, and mentor junior engineers. Your work will contribute to the safety, efficiency, and innovation of next-generation automotive systems.

Your Tasks:

- Responsibility for the transistor-level design of complex analog and mixed-signal circuits in coordination with other designers
- Defining and implementing analog blocks in BCD technologies, such as SMPSs, LDOs, gate drivers, charge pumps, sensor interfaces, and protection circuits
- Breaking down system-level requirements into block-level design targets and support specification clarification
- Discussing and investigating chip requirements with internal customers and align technical assumptions with stakeholders
- Collaborating with digital design, layout, verification, and test teams to support smooth chip integration
- Driving chip-level and analog-on-top integration activities, including schematic consistency, simulations, and interface alignment
- Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to knowledge sharing within the analog design team

Qualifications

- Academic degree in electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics or comparable qualification
- Expert level of experience in analog/mixed-signal high-voltage, high-power ASIC design in the automotive domain
- Longterm Experience with analog-on-top simulation environments and mixed-signal verification
- Strong Knowledge of BCD technologies
- Proven track record of tape-outs and successful silicon validation
- Knowledge of functional safety and reliability engineering
- Exposure to EMC/ESD design and robustness testing
- Strong understanding of analog circuit theory, and physical layout considerations
- Familiarity with automotive-grade design constraints and qualification processes
- Very good English language skills (written and spoken)

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.
Who will you join?

The Accounting Policy Department deals with the resolution of critical accounting requests from OEs, Group Management and the Group Auditor.

How can you make an impact?

You will:

- Provide IFRS (and Solvency II) guidance to Allianz Group entities worldwide and Group Center management with a focus on general accounting topics and financial instruments (IFRS 9)
- Determine the appropriate inclusion method and classification of investments under IFRS 10/11/12, IAS 28, IFRS 9

- Monitor emerging accounting issues and research the impact of proposed changes; support the implementation of new IFRS accounting standards
- Support the Group-wide training program with a focus on general accounting topics; give presentations on specific accounting and related industry topics at meetings, seminars, programs or external conferences
- Work closely with our Group APD Outposts, a group of 40 business and accounting professionals from all major Allianz Group entities
- Participate in the work of national and international committees and associations in relation to accounting standards and policies; e.g. prepare comment letters for the IASB

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Deep IFRS accounting knowledge, profound experience (5+ years)
- Previous employment within an accounting policy function of a large corporate, with a Big 4 company or withan academic background is a plus
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Very good analytical skills
- Highly organized and risk-oriented approach
- High motivation and ability to work efficiently and independently
- Conflict management skills
- Previous experience in business-related functions (e.i. Sales, Operations, Claims, Underwriting, Investment Management, Asset Management, Consulting, Product Development, Finance, Market Management, Digital /Tech etc.) is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

- University degree in accounting, economics or related field
- Additional academic/professional qualifications (e.g. PhD, MBA, WP, StB, CPA, CFA) required
- Fluent in Business English, written and spoken; German skills a plus
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

title: Sales Manager
description:
Welcome to HARALD PIHL – where metals meet people, and curiosity meets craftsmanship.

We're a family-owned company with over 110 years of history, but our mindset is anything but old-fashioned. Here, professionalism goes hand in hand with warmth, teamwork and a healthy dose of positive energy.

We believe in being curious, solution-oriented and honest in everything we do – and we're proud of the culture we build together, across borders, roles and locations.

If you enjoy taking responsibility, making things better than they were yesterday, and being part of a company that truly cares about both results and people, you might feel right at home with us.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join HARALD PIHL GmbH and help us continue growing our business in Germany.

This position can be based either from our office in Krefeld or remotely. We are particularly interested in candidates located in Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria or surrounding regions.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining customer relationships within the market for titanium, nickel-based alloys and other specialty metals. You will manage the entire sales process, from identifying opportunities and preparing quotations to negotiating agreements and securing long-term customer partnerships.

You will work closely with customers in industries such as Aerospace, Defence, Medical, Energy and Advanced Manufacturing, helping them find the right material solutions for their applications.

The role combines relationship-building, technical sales and business development, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently while being part of an international and highly specialized organization.

Your mission is to strengthen our market position, create new business opportunities and deliver outstanding service to both new and existing customers.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities will include, among others:

    Managing and developing customer relationships within your sales region
    Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding our customer base
    Preparing quotations, following up on opportunities, and negotiating prices and commercial agreements
    Advising customers on materials, applications, and suitable product solutions
    Conducting customer visits and representing HARALD PIHL at meetings and industry events
    Managing customer projects from enquiry through order placement
    Working closely with internal teams to ensure excellent customer service and delivery performance
    Monitoring market developments, trends, and competitor activities
    Maintaining customer information and activities in CRM and ERP systems
    Supporting the development of sales strategies and business plans
    Contributing to continuous improvements and growth initiatives across the business

As our business continues to grow, the role may evolve with additional responsibilities and development opportunities over time.

Who we're looking for

Required experience & knowledge

    Several years of B2B sales experience within metals, steel, specialty alloys, engineering materials or related technical industries
    Proven experience developing customer relationships and driving commercial growth
    Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills
    Experience managing the full sales cycle
    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office 365
    Experience working with CRM and ERP systems
    Fluent German and English, written and spoken
    Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly within the region

Nice to have

    Experience within titanium, nickel-based alloys or specialty metals
    An existing network within relevant industrial sectors
    Commercial education or degree in business, engineering or a related field
    Experience with Monitor ERP
    Experience working with customers in Aerospace, Defence, Medical or Energy industries

Personal competencies

We believe how you work is just as important as what you know. For this role, we value that you are:

    Relationship-oriented – you naturally build trust and enjoy creating long-term business relationships
    Solution-oriented – you focus on finding practical and commercially viable solutions for customers
    Structured – you organize your work effectively, follow through on commitments and maintain a high level of quality
    Cooperative – you enjoy working with colleagues, customers, and partners to achieve shared goals

What it's like to work with us

At HARALD PIHL, you'll join a company where people genuinely enjoy working together.

We combine the agility of a local organization with the opportunities of an international business. You'll have significant freedom and responsibility in your role, while also benefiting from the support of experienced colleagues and a strong team culture.

We offer a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where ideas are welcomed, initiatives are encouraged and long-term relationships matter. Most importantly, you'll become part of a company with deep specialist expertise, a strong market position and a long-standing reputation as a trusted partner to customers around the world. If you're looking for a role where your expertise can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Wil jij jezelf ontwikkelen richting projectleider en werken aan technische projecten in het buitenland? Dan is dit jouw kans om het vak in de praktijk te leren binnen een internationale omgeving.
Voor onze goede relatie zoeken wij een junior projectleider die wil groeien in het vak en stap voor stap verantwoordelijkheid neemt binnen uitdagende technische projecten.
Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren projectleiders en krijgt begeleiding terwijl je steeds meer zelfstandig werkzaamheden oppakt en projecten leert aansturen.


Voor onze goede relatie zoeken wij een junior projectleider die wil groeien in het vak en stap voor stap verantwoordelijkheid neemt binnen uitdagende technische projecten.
Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren projectleiders en krijgt begeleiding terwijl je steeds meer zelfstandig werkzaamheden oppakt en projecten leert aansturen.
Je komt te werken in een praktische- en technisch gedreven organisatie waar aanpakken belangrijker is dan praten. Geen overbodige lagen of ingewikkelde processen. Als Junior Projectleider ondersteun je bij de voorbereiding, coördinatie en uitvoering van projecten en leer je alle facetten van projectmanagement in de praktijk.
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
Ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en organisatie van projecten;
Meewerken aan planningen, werkvoorbereiding en uitvoering;
Contact onderhouden met projectteams, leveranciers en partners;
Begeleiden en opvolgen van werkzaamheden op projectlocaties in Duitsland;
Signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken in oplossingen;
Ondersteunen bij rapportages en projectadministratie;
Meegaan naar projectlocaties om praktijkervaring op te doen.

title: Physiotherapeut m/w/d (Physiotherapeut/in)
description:
PHYSIOTHERAPEUT:IN GESUCHT

Für Menschen, die ihren Beruf wirklich ausüben wollen – nicht nur Rezepte abarbeiten.

Wir wachsen. Und wir haben noch einiges vor.

Bei TheraPhysio im GEP in Germering geht es uns nicht darum, möglichst viele Patient:innen möglichst schnell durch einen Behandlungstag zu schleusen.

Wir möchten verstehen, warum jemand Beschwerden hat.

Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, langfristig etwas zu verändern.

Und wir möchten Physiotherapie so anbieten, wie wir selbst sie uns wünschen würden: kompetent, individuell, menschlich und mit Zeit für den Menschen.

Deshalb suchen wir eine:n Physiotherapeut:in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Was Physiotherapie für uns bedeutet:

Ein guter Befund ist für uns wichtiger als ein Schema F.

Wir behandeln nicht einfach eine Schulter, ein Knie oder einen Rücken – sondern einen Menschen mit seiner Geschichte, seinem Alltag, seinen Belastungen und seinen Zielen.

Therapie bedeutet für uns deshalb nicht nur „Schmerzen weg“, sondern möglichst auch: Ursachen verstehen. Bewegung wieder möglich machen. Vertrauen schaffen. Eigenverantwortung fördern. Und Veränderungen erreichen, die bleiben.

Dazu gehören bei uns klassische physiotherapeutische Behandlungen genauso wie aktive Therapie, medizinisches Training und Prävention.

Mit unserem Trainingsbereich, unter anderem mit Milon, Five und Skillcourt, und Angeboten wie KGG, T-RENA und RV Fit können wir Patient:innen weit über die klassische Einzelbehandlung hinaus begleiten.

Und genau dieser Bereich wird in Zukunft noch deutlich wachsen.

Wohin wir wollen:

Unsere Praxis entwickelt sich Schritt für Schritt zu einem umfassenden Therapie- und Gesundheitszentrum, in dem Therapie, Training und Prävention miteinander verbunden werden.

Dabei möchten wir moderne Medizin und moderne Technik nutzen, ohne das zu verlieren, was unseren Beruf ausmacht: den persönlichen Kontakt zwischen Menschen.

Digitale Prozesse, elektronische Dokumentation und künftig auch KI können uns Organisation abnehmen und Wissen schneller verfügbar machen.

Sie sollen aber niemals die Therapeutin oder den Therapeuten ersetzen.

Im Gegenteil: Technik soll uns dabei helfen, mehr Zeit für das zu haben, was wirklich wichtig ist – unsere Patient:innen.

Wen wir suchen:

Du musst nicht alles können.

Du musst auch nicht zwanzig Fortbildungen gesammelt haben.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst und wie du mit Menschen umgehst.

Du passt wahrscheinlich gut zu uns, wenn du …

* gerne wirklich herausfinden möchtest, warum jemand Beschwerden hat,

* Therapie nicht als Fließbandarbeit verstehst,

* Patient:innen ernst nimmst und gut kommunizieren kannst,

* Spaß an aktiver Therapie und Training hast,

* dich fachlich weiterentwickeln möchtest,

* Verantwortung übernehmen kannst,

* offen für neue Ideen und moderne Technik bist,

* und trotzdem weißt, dass keine Technik Empathie, Erfahrung und therapeutisches Gespür ersetzt.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Arbeitsplatz, an dem du Physiotherapeut:in sein darfst.

Ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Physiotherapie, Sporttherapie und Sportwissenschaft.

Großzügige Therapie- und Trainingsflächen statt Behandlung ausschließlich hinter geschlossenen Kabinentüren.

Moderne Trainingsgeräte und Möglichkeiten, Patient:innen vom ersten Befund bis zurück in einen aktiven Alltag zu begleiten.

Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildung.

Und vor allem:

Wir wollen gemeinsam etwas aufbauen.

Unsere Praxis wächst – räumlich, fachlich und konzeptionell. Wer heute zu uns kommt, kann diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten und muss sich nicht einfach in ein fertiges System einfügen.

Und was wir nicht suchen:

Wir suchen niemanden, der morgens kommt, seine Termine abarbeitet und nachmittags möglichst wenig mit dem Rest des Teams zu tun haben möchte.

Fachwissen kann man erweitern.

Fortbildungen kann man machen.

Methoden kann man lernen.

Interesse an Menschen, Verantwortungsgefühl und die Motivation, gute Arbeit machen zu wollen, lassen sich deutlich schwerer beibringen.

Wenn du dich darin wiederfindest, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Auch dann, wenn du aktuell eigentlich gar nicht aktiv auf Jobsuche bist.

📍 TheraPhysio im GEP | Germering

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

- Kurze Entscheidungswege & direkte Ansprechpartner im täglichen Arbeiten
- Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung zzgl. Zuschlägen

- Fachkundige Einschätzung medizinischer Situationen und Ableitung geeigneter weiterer Maßnahmen

- Begleitung von Patientinnen und Patienten bei internationalen medizinischen Escort‑Missionen (z.B. Linien‑ oder Ambulanzflüge, Boden‑Evakuierungen) inkl. medizinischer Betreuung während des Transports
- Dokumentation und transparente Entscheidungsfindung - eigenständig sowie im interdisziplinären Team
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit medizinischen Expertinnen und Experten sowie operativen Kolleginnen und Kollegen in einem globalen Netzwerk

- Sehr gutes medizinisches Urteilsvermögen und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

- Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Sicherer Umgang mit MS‑Office‑Anwendungen

Von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung:

- Erfahrung mit medizinischen Begleittransporten oder Evakuierungen

- Arbeiten in einem marktführenden Unternehmen mit klarer Mission: Menschen weltweit medizinisch sicher begleiten.

- Fachgerechter Speisen- und Getränkeservice auf 2-Sterne-Niveau
- Präzises Servieren, Abräumen und Arbeiten am Gasttisch
- Erlernen und sicheres Beherrschen der jeweiligen Menüfolge sowie aller einzelnen Komponenten
- Aufbau eines fundierten Verständnisses für unsere Produkte, Zubereitungsmethoden sowie die französisch-japanische Ausrichtung des IKIGAI
- Unterstützung bei der Präsentation und Erklärung der einzelnen Gerichte am Tisch
- Aufbau von Grundkenntnissen in den Bereichen Wein, Sake, Spirituosen sowie alkoholfreie Getränkebegleitungen
- Unterstützung der Sommelière und schrittweises Erlernen eines professionellen Wein- und Getränkeservices
- Aufmerksame Beobachtung des Gastraums sowie frühzeitiges Erkennen und Erfüllen von Gästewünschen
- Enge Abstimmung mit Chef de Rang, Restaurantleitung, Sommelière und Küche
- Sicherstellen eines ruhigen und strukturierten Serviceablaufs auch in intensiven Situationen
- Pflege und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigem Geschirr, Gläsern, Besteck und Serviceequipment
- Einhaltung unserer Hygiene-, Qualitäts- und Servicestandards
- aktive Teilnahme an Briefings, Menübesprechungen, Tastings und Trainings

Ihre Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, über die wir uns freuen

- Sie müssen noch kein fertiger Sterne-Service-Mitarbeiter sein – entscheidend sind Ihre Gastgeberpersönlichkeit, Lernbereitschaft und die Motivation, sich in der Spitzengastronomie weiterzuentwickeln.
- Erste Erfahrung im Restaurantservice, idealerweise in der gehobenen Gastronomie oder Hotellerie
- Eine abgeschlossene gastronomische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil, aber bei entsprechender Erfahrung und Persönlichkeit nicht zwingend Voraussetzung
- Ausgeprägte Gastgebermentalität und echtes Interesse am Gast
- Natürliches, herzliches und gleichzeitig professionelles Auftreten
- Sehr gute Umgangsformen ohne übertriebene Förmlichkeit
- Aufmerksamkeit und ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen
- Ruhe und Konzentrationsfähigkeit während des Services
- Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an Fine Dining
- Echtes Interesse an Lebensmitteln, Küche, Wein und Getränken
- Bereitschaft, sich intensiv mit den Gerichten und deren Hintergründen auseinanderzusetzen
- Teamfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft, sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen
- Zuverlässigkeit, Sauberkeit und ein hoher eigener Qualitätsanspruch
- Fähigkeit, Feedback anzunehmen und unmittelbar umzusetzen
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Kommunikation mit unseren internationalen Gästen

Neben Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation suchen wir vor allem eine Persönlichkeit, die unsere Servicephilosophie lebt. Wir glauben an eine Gastfreundschaft, die durch Aufmerksamkeit, Präzision und echtes Feingefühl überzeugt – nicht durch Inszenierung. Denn außergewöhnlicher Service entsteht, wenn im richtigen Moment ganz selbstverständlich das Richtige geschieht.

Unser Anspruch ist dabei klar:

- Präzision ohne Steifheit.

title: Sozialarbeiter_in / Sozialpädagog_in (m/w/d) für unsere Zentrale Anlaufstelle (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Der Caritasverband für Stuttgart e.V. (CVS) ist der Wohlfahrtsverband der Katholischen Kirche in Stuttgart. Die Zentrale Anlaufstelle (ZAS) ist eine Beratungsstelle für neuzugewanderte Unionsbürger_innen, die wohnungslos oder von Wohnungslosigkeit bedroht sind. Die Betroffenen sind in der Regel vom Zugang zum regulären Hilfesystem und Transferleistungen ausgeschlossen. Der Dienst wird in Kooperation mit der Evangelischen Gesellschaft geführt und ist Teil des Fachdienstes Offene Hilfen im Bereich Armut Wohnungslosigkeit und Schulden (CVS).

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für unsere Zentrale Anlaufstelle eine_n

Sozialarbeiter_in / Sozialpädagog_in (m/w/d)

Stellenumfang 50%, unbefristet

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Beratung und aufsuchende Arbeit von wohnungslosen Unionsbürger_innen: Alleinstehenden, Paaren und Familien
- Beratung bei existenziellen Notlagen, ggf. Zuweisung in Notübernachtungsplätze, sowie Anbindung an das Wohnungsnotfallhilfesystem
- Enge Zusammenarbeit und Kooperation mit Einrichtungen und Diensten des gesamten Hilfesystems in Stuttgart, Netzwerkarbeit

Wir bieten Ihnen:

- Eine interessante und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem großen Sozialunternehmen
- Umfangreiche Angebote und Vergünstigungen im Bereich Fortbildungen, Gesundheitsförderung, Sport und Kultur, Job Rad
- Vergütung bei einer 39h-Woche und Erfüllung aller fachlichen Qualifikationen S12 AVR (3.967€ - 5.454€ entspr. Berufserfahrung) plus Jahressonderzahlung
- Mitarbeit in einem engagierten, qualifizierten Team; Supervision

Sie bringen mit:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium als Sozialarbeiter_in oder Sozialpädagoge_in
- Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in der Beratung von Menschen in existenziellen Notlagen
- Ein besonderes Engagement für den Personenkreis
- Gute rechtliche Grundlagen im SGB II und SGB XII
- Selbständiges, strukturiertes und sorgfältiges Arbeiten
- Osteuropäische Sprachkompetenzen sind sehr erwünscht

Bunt ist schön. Bei uns ist jede und jeder willkommen – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität.

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte bevorzugt online über unsere Bewerbermaske oder per E-Mail (max. 12 MB) bis 07.09.2026 an Bewerbung-AWS@caritas-stuttgart.de

Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen Frau Schiefelbein-Beck gerne telefonisch unter 0711 23879-65 zur Verfügung.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.

. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. . Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.

. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. Do you enjoy balancing technical fieldwork with meaningful ecological impact? Are you ready to lead surveys, mentor early-career colleagues, and deliver high-quality reports? Are you looking for a role that offers variety, autonomy, and the chance to shape your ecological career? We’re looking for a Senior Ecologist to join Woodrow (part of the APEM Group) in Ireland. You will work with other ecology professionals in our office in Sligo. Around 50% of your time will involve fieldwork, including travel across Ireland (and occasionally Northern Ireland or the UK), so confidence working in dynamic, outdoor settings is key. As a Senior Ecologist, you’ll lead survey programmes, deliver technical reports (e.g. EcIA, AA Screening, NIS, EIAR), manage small to mid-sized projects, and guide junior ecologists. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to tender writing, service development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration with experts across the wider APEM Group. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: A third-level qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Botany, or a related field 3–5+ years of experience in ecological consultancy or similar Strong field survey skills and working knowledge of Irish flora and fauna Experience producing ecological impact assessments and technical reports aligned with Irish planning law A good understanding of Irish and EU legislation (Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, Planning and Development Act) Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal Ability to manage projects independently, including budgets, schedules, and client relationships A full clean EU driving licence and willingness to travel for fieldwork Bonus points for: CIEEM Associate Membership (or eligibility), and interest in progressing toward Full Membership or Chartership Experience managing field teams and mentoring junior staff Familiarity with GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS) First Aid or remote fieldwork safety training (training can be provided) You will be offered the chance to work on a variety of projects, many of our employees have worked on projects that have been of personal interest to them. We match this with a commitment to continuous development and learning to support your career. We also offer benefits to look after you, from private medical insurance for all employees, access to mental health first aiders and comprehensive income protection if you cannot work. We also offer superb flexible working options, balancing work with your life.

Job Description Thindi Phibsborough is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Chef de Partie to join our dynamic kitchen team on a full-time, permanent basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing a designated section of the kitchen, preparing and presenting high-quality dishes, maintaining exceptional food safety and hygiene standards, and supporting the efficient day-to-day operation of the kitchen. The role requires strong culinary expertise, excellent organisational abilities, and the ability to perform consistently in a fast-paced hospitality environment while delivering outstanding food quality and customer satisfaction. Key Duties and Responsibilities Manage and oversee an assigned kitchen section, ensuring smooth and efficient service throughout each shift. Prepare, cook, and present a wide range of dishes in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines. Organise daily mise en place to ensure all ingredients and equipment are prepared before service. Monitor food quality, consistency, portion control, and presentation to maintain company standards. Ensure full compliance with HACCP procedures, food safety legislation, hygiene regulations, and allergen management requirements. Assist in menu preparation and contribute ideas for seasonal dishes and special menu offerings. Supervise, train, and support junior chefs and kitchen assistants to promote teamwork and maintain operational standards. Maintain a clean, organised, and safe kitchen environment, ensuring all workstations and equipment are sanitised at all times. Collaborate closely with the Head Chef and kitchen management team to improve kitchen efficiency and maintain excellent service standards. Ensure compliance with all company policies, health and safety legislation, and standard operating procedures. Candidate Requirements Essential Relevant qualification in Culinary Arts, Professional Cookery, Hospitality, or equivalent practical experience. A minimum of two years' professional chef experience in a commercial kitchen environment is essential. Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, Chef, or Assistant Chef in a busy restaurant or hospitality environment. Strong knowledge of food preparation techniques, kitchen operations, and commercial cooking methods. Excellent understanding of HACCP principles, food safety regulations, hygiene standards, and allergen management. Experience with stock control, inventory management, food ordering, and waste reduction. Ability to supervise junior kitchen staff and maintain high standards during busy service periods. Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.

title: Senior Ecologist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Do you enjoy balancing technical fieldwork with meaningful ecological impact? Are you ready to lead surveys, mentor early-career colleagues, and deliver high-quality reports? Are you looking for a role that offers variety, autonomy, and the chance to shape your ecological career? We’re looking for a Senior Ecologist to join Woodrow (part of the APEM Group) in Ireland. This is an exciting opportunity to take the next step in your consultancy career—delivering high-quality ecological assessments, leading fieldwork across diverse Irish habitats, and contributing to nationally significant environmental projects. You will work with other ecology professionals in our office in Sligo. Around 50% of your time will involve fieldwork, including travel across Ireland (and occasionally Northern Ireland or the UK), so confidence working in dynamic, outdoor settings is key. As a Senior Ecologist, you’ll lead survey programmes, deliver technical reports (e.g. EcIA, AA Screening, NIS, EIAR), manage small to mid-sized projects, and guide junior ecologists. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to tender writing, service development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration with experts across the wider APEM Group. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: A third-level qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Botany, or a related field 3–5+ years of experience in ecological consultancy or similar Strong field survey skills and working knowledge of Irish flora and fauna Experience producing ecological impact assessments and technical reports aligned with Irish planning law A good understanding of Irish and EU legislation (Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, Planning and Development Act) Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal Ability to manage projects independently, including budgets, schedules, and client relationships A full clean EU driving licence and willingness to travel for fieldwork Bonus points for: CIEEM Associate Membership (or eligibility), and interest in progressing toward Full Membership or Chartership Experience managing field teams and mentoring junior staff Familiarity with GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS) First Aid or remote fieldwork safety training (training can be provided) You will be offered the chance to work on a variety of projects, many of our employees have worked on projects that have been of personal interest to them. We match this with a commitment to continuous development and learning to support your career. We also offer benefits to look after you, from private medical insurance for all employees, access to mental health first aiders and comprehensive income protection if you cannot work. We also offer superb flexible working options, balancing work with your life.

title: Jetty Operator - Dublin
description:

 Have you got what it takes to be our new Jetty Operator in Dublin? We want to hear from you! What would your day at GAC look like? Ensuring vessels are moored correctly and in alignment with shore loading arms and connections Ensuring vessels provide safe access via correctly rigged gangways, which must be monitored and maintained throughout discharge operations Connection and disconnection of ‘off-loading equipment’ (hoses/loading arms/spool pieces etc.) Monitoring and adjusting connections, as required Ensuring valves are opened/closed for safe, efficient discharge of client products Taking ship samples, as required Performing line walks and repetitive checks during discharge operations Completion of documentation as required What are we looking for? A good understanding and appreciation of a proactive safety culture Strong communication skills A positive attitude and a willingness to learn Marine or Terminal experience desired but not necessary as all full training will be provided Full clean driving licence Manual handling certificate (desired but not essential) First Aid certificate (desired but not essential)   What’s in it for you? This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do. With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.   As our Jetty Operator in Dublin, you will have the opportunity to work as part of a team who apply the highest standard of customer services to everything we do and aim to be industry leaders within all the sectors we serve.   GAC Ireland gives you the opportunity to work for an employer who is committed to offering all our staff an enjoyable and rewarding career, with significant training and development prospects. In 2021, we launched our ten-year sustainability programme – MARS30. We are committed to “growing long term customer relationships across multiple products, whilst significantly reducing our environmental impact, improving the well-being of our people, and influencing our stakeholders to do the same.” We will accomplish our by mission by completing objectives aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).     At GAC Ireland, who you are is just as important as what you do. The GAC Spirit reflects our culture across the company, emphasising loyalty and understanding between management and staff. We recognise that people’s lives extend far beyond their jobs. By promoting a healthy combination of work and play

title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 80 hotels in 12 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

Looking after our guests in a professional manner at the front desk is extremely important at all times – from a warm welcome at check-in until their departure, your job will be to assist our early risers and night owls. Your duties will also include the following:

- Welcoming guests, checking in and out.
- Preparing daily closing balances
- Cash transactions and cashing up

Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. description: ADDETTO/A ALL'ASSEMBLAGGIO MECCANICO Per realtà metalmeccanica ricerchiamo una figura da inserire come addetto assemblaggio con scopo inserimento. SCOPO DEL RUOLO Assemblare correttamente le parti meccaniche nel rispetto delle indicazioni ricevute e delle procedure aziendali. Supportare il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei macchinari. RESPONSABILITA' Puntualità e correttezza nell'esecuzione delle procedure di assemblaggio Pulizia e manutenzione dei macchinari Messa in sicurezza delle macchine Ottemperamento degli standard di qualità aziendali Rispetto delle tempistiche previste PRINCIPALI MANSIONI Si occupa dell'assemblaggio meccanico dei componenti di una ginocchiera: posiziona manualmente i velcri adesivi, assembla i passanti, le cuffie e la parte superiore ed inferiore delle ginocchiera tramite una piastrina che viene rivettata, piega le parti in alluminio e confeziona manualmente la ginocchiera. Sulla base delle necessità produttive, utilizza le macchine rivettatrici, le presse, le calandre, le imboccolatrici, prestando attenzione alla corretta messa in sicurezza della macchina e al corretto settaggio prima dell'uso. Verifica la sicurezza e la funzionalità dei macchinari che utilizza quotidianamente. Segue con attenzione le istruzioni per il corretto assemblaggio di ogni parte di ciascuna lavorazione. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. COMPETENZE TECNICHE Preferibili conoscenze delle procedure di assemblaggio dei componenti meccanici Preferibile conoscenza dei macchinari utilizzati in azienda (presse, calandre, imboccolatrici) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di attrezzature manuali (cacciaviti, pinze) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti elettrici (avvitatori, trapani) Orario di lavoro: full-time dal lunedì al venerdì 08.00-12.00/13.00-17.00 Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato - CCNL applicato: metalmeccanici PMI - Livello di inquadramento: 3° livello - Retribuzione prevista: circa 2000 lordi mensili Luogo di lavoro: Dossobuono di Villafranca (Vr) Via A. Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione.
