title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

title: Fachkrankenpfleger/in - Intensivpflege/Anästhesie, Experte Anästhesiepflege (w/m/d) Schweiz (Fachkrankenpfleger/in - Intensivpflege/Anästhesie)
description:
Arbeiten in der Schweiz

Moderne Anästhesiepflege mit attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen

Für eine renommierte Gesundheitseinrichtung in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir im Auftrag unseres Schweizer Netzwerks eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Experte Anästhesiepflege (w/m/d).

Sie erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit zeitgemäßer Infrastruktur, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem motivierten interdisziplinären Team. Die Position bietet Ihnen ausgezeichnete Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen in der Schweiz.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Fachgerechte Betreuung und Überwachung von Patientinnen und Patienten vor, während und nach anästhesiologischen Eingriffen
- Vorbereitung und Kontrolle der anästhesierelevanten Geräte und Materialien
- Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Allgemein- und Regionalanästhesien
- Sicherstellung eines sicheren und reibungslosen Ablaufs im Operationsbereich
- Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten und Pflegefachpersonen
- Aktive Mitwirkung an der Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung der Abläufe

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachkrankenpfleger/in - Intensivpflege/Anästhesie  oder eine vergleichbare anerkannte Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung im Bereich Anästhesiepflege von Vorteil
- Hohe Fachkompetenz sowie selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
- Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit
- Freude an einer patientenorientierten Arbeitsweise
- Bereitschaft, in der Deutschschweiz tätig zu werden

Das erwartet Sie

- Attraktive Vergütung nach Schweizer Standards
- Moderne technische Ausstattung und hochwertige Arbeitsbedingungen
- Strukturierte Einarbeitung
- Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige berufliche Perspektiven
- Hohe Lebensqualität in der Schweiz
- Unterstützung bei allen administrativen Schritten rund um den Stellenwechsel

Ihre Vorteile mit TalentBridge Consulting

TalentBridge Consulting begleitet qualifizierte Fachkräfte persönlich und professionell auf dem Weg in die Schweiz.

Unsere Unterstützung umfasst unter anderem:

- Persönliche Beratung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses
- Vorstellung bei ausgewählten Schweizer Arbeitgebern
- Unterstützung bei Anerkennungsverfahren
- Begleitung bis zum erfolgreichen Stellenantritt
- Beratung zu Relocation und administrativen Fragen

Unsere Unterstützung und Vermittlung ist für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber selbstverständlich kostenlos, da sie im Auftrag Schweizer Arbeitgeber erfolgt.

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Ausbildungsnachweisen, Arbeitszeugnissen sowie Ihrem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin.

title: Philanthropy Advisor for Private Major Donors - German
description:
Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF’s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support. This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions. You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team’s fundraising approach.
Tasks & Responsibilities
Qualification, cultivation and stewardship
•    Manages a portfolio of Major donors
•    Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
•    Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
•    In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
•    Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
•    Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF’s work
•    Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
•    Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
•    Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
•    Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
•    Keep the database up-to-date
•    Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
•    Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
Solicitation
•    Present and defend MSF’s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
•    Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
Information and data management
•    Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
•    Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
Others
•    Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
•    Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.
Your profile
Education
•    University degree in Business Management, Marketing, Communications, Political Science, Law, International Relations or equivalent
Experience
•    Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in similar functions or in the fields of  high-level relational skills, like public relations, wealth management or sales/marketing/communications, high-level advocacy or humanitarian project work
•    Experience in using Microsoft Dynamics or other Customer Relationship Manager System: a plus
•    Experience and knowledge of humanitarian aid: a plus
Languages
•    (Swiss) German (native or equivalent),
•    English
•    French : a plus
•    Italian: a plus
Skills/ Technical competencies
•    Proven writing skills
•    Excellent in oral public presentations
•    Use of data base a plus
Personal Abilities/Qualities
•    Excellent interpersonal skills
•    Rigorous and good organizational skills
•    Empathic, enthusiastic, optimistic
•    Result orientation
•    Team spirit
•    Strong commitment to MSF’s social mission and values
Terms of employment
•    Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
•    Open-ended contract
•    Working place: Zürich
•    Ideal start date: asap
•    Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
•    Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
•    Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
•    Relocation support available for eligible candidates.
How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
•    CV (maximum 2 pages)
•    Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
•    Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is 30th August, 2026.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

title: Global Traffic & Creative Operations Manager
description:
Global Traffic \& Creative Operations Manager  
Born of a simple gesture in 1976, L'Occitane en Provence reveals the living power of flora, where the light of the sun meets the richness of the earth. With advanced expertise, we turn these natural treasures into sensorial, efficient experiences, as sustainable as possible and profoundly inspired by Haute Provencal nature.  
Our culture is built through everyday moments, how we behave, make decisions and show up for each other.  
With Trust as our foundation, Curiosity as our compass, Excellence as our standard, we create lasting Impact for the people around us and our planet. We create unique sensory experiences, to share precious moments with simplicity.  
With retail locations in over 90 countries, your career can take you anywhere. Proud to be B Corp certified, we are part of a global movement working towards a more inclusive, equitable and regenerative economy.  
L'Occitane en Provence is part of the L'OCCITANE Group, a leading international, multi\-brand manufacturer and retailer of premium beauty and wellness products.  
We offer diverse opportunities to grow and make a difference on a global scale.  
Context \& Mission  
We are looking for an experienced Global Traffic \& Creative Operations Manager to coordinate creative workflows across Headquarters and six international Creative Hubs.  
Joining the creative services team, this role sits at the center of the global creative ecosystem, ensuring clear prioritization, efficient delivery, and real\-time visibility across Creative Campaigns, Visual Merchandising, Store Design and Packaging. The position also drives smarter ways of working through streamlined processes, automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and connected tools.  
You will help creative teams deliver impactful brand experiences consistently across markets while improving operational efficiency through data, systems, and technology.  
You will report to the Head of Brand Creative Services \& Production.  
Key responsibilities  
Manage brief intake and project prioritization — validate creative requests, scope needs, align priorities, and balance business demand with team capacity.  
Own the HQ creative pipeline — track status, timelines, owners, risks, and delivery across disciplines from kick\-off to completion.  
Build and optimize operating systems — design intake forms, routing logic, approvals, automation, dashboards, and scalable traffic processes.  
Lead automation and AI\-enabled workflow initiatives — identify repetitive tasks and implement practical solutions with IT and technical partners.  
Improve time\-to\-market — identify bottlenecks, reduce lead times, and simplify recurring workflows without compromising quality.  
Facilitate traffic rituals and stakeholder alignment — lead status meetings, surface risks, and keep teams aligned with minimal operational friction.  
Maintain capacity and resource visibility — monitor team workload, flag bottlenecks, and anticipate surge needs with creative leads.  
Coordinate across six Creative Hubs — align priorities, timelines, and process standards for global and multi\-market projects.

title: Chef de projet technique
description:
Chef de projet technique H/F  
Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.  
Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre d'un important programme de modernisation de son système d'information, notre client recherche un(e) Chef(fe) de Projet Technique Infrastructure / DevOps. Vous évoluerez au sein d'une Direction des Systèmes d'Information en charge d'applications critiques et de plateformes techniques à forte disponibilité. Ce poste s'adresse à un professionnel issu des métiers de l'infrastructure ou du DevOps ayant progressivement évolué vers la gestion de projets techniques. Votre rôle sera de coordonner les projets d'infrastructure, accompagner les équipes techniques dans leurs évolutions, participer aux choix d'architecture et contribuer à la modernisation des plateformes ainsi qu'à la réduction de la dette technologique. Vos responsabilités En lien avec les architectes, les ingénieurs DevOps, les équipes de développement et les partenaires infrastructure, vous aurez notamment pour missions de : Piloter des projets techniques liés aux infrastructures, aux plateformes DevOps et aux environnements d'exécution des applications. Organiser et coordonner l'ensemble des phases des projets : analyse, conception, planification, mise en œuvre, recette, déploiement et mise en production. Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Infrastructure, DevOps, Développement, Architecture et les fournisseurs. Participer aux travaux d'architecture technique et contribuer aux orientations des plateformes d'hébergement et de déploiement. Accompagner les projets de modernisation des infrastructures et piloter les actions de réduction de la dette technique et de gestion de l'obsolescence. Superviser les évolutions des plateformes OpenShift, Linux et des chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continu. Veiller à la disponibilité, aux performances, à la sécurité et à la résilience des infrastructures techniques. Suivre les risques, les dépendances et les indicateurs de pilotage des projets. Participer à la définition des bonnes pratiques DevOps, d'automatisation et d'industrialisation. Contribuer aux plans de continuité d'activité, aux procédures d'exploitation ainsi qu'à la documentation technique. Assurer une veille technologique afin d'identifier les solutions permettant d'améliorer les performances, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle.  
Profil recherché  
Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes d'information ou domaine équivalent. Minimum 5 années d'expérience en gestion de projets techniques ou d'infrastructure. Expérience préalable en tant qu'Ingénieur Infrastructure, Ingénieur Systèmes, DevOps ou Architecte Technique. Solide expérience des environnements OpenShift ou Kubernetes on\-premise. Bonne maîtrise des environnements Linux et de leur administration. Expérience des chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continu (GitLab CI, Jenkins ou équivalent). Connaissance des outils d'automatisation et de gestion de configuration tels qu'Ansible ou Puppet. Bonne compréhension des architectures d'infrastructure, des réseaux, de la sécurité et des environnements de production. Un\-e technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès (100 %) \- CDI  
L'EVAM (Établissement vaudois de l'accueil des migrants) est un acteur majeur du service public vaudois. Avec plus de 1'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs engagés et un budget annuel de 360 millions de francs, nous assurons l'accueil, l'accompagnement et l'intégration des personnes migrantes dans le canton de Vaud.  
Chaque jour, nos équipes œuvrent avec ouverture et responsabilité pour répondre à des enjeux sociaux essentiels. Rejoindre l'EVAM, c'est mettre ses compétences au service d'une mission humaine et d'utilité publique, dans un environnement professionnel stimulant, diversifié et en constante évolution.  
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recrutons :  
Un\-e technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès électronique et mécanique (100 %) \- CDI  
Lieu : Lausanne avec déplacements sur l'ensemble des sites de l'EVAM dans le canton de Vaud

Classe salariale : 5 (ce barème s'entend à prérequis validés, à défaut desquels l'enclassement se fait à hauteur de classe \-1\)

En tant que technicien\-ne en système de contrôle d'accès électronique et mécanique, vous assurez la sécurité et le bon fonctionnement des installations de contrôle d'accès sur l'ensemble des sites de l'EVAM.  
Vous intervenez aussi bien sur de nouveaux projets que sur des installations existantes, en pilotant les aspects techniques, la coordination des travaux et la maintenance des équipements. Grâce à votre expertise, vous garantissez des infrastructures fiables, conformes aux normes en vigueur et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.  
Vous évoluez dans une fonction variée, mêlant terrain, coordination de chantiers, dépannage et gestion technique, au sein d'une équipe autonome et orientée solutions.  
Le mot de votre futur responsable, Robin :  
« Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est intégrer un environnement où la sécurité est une priorité et où chacun contribue, par son expertise, à améliorer nos infrastructures. Aucune journée ne se ressemble : interventions de terrain, suivi de chantiers, projets techniques, nouvelles technologies et collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires rythment notre quotidien. Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, autonome, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui apprécie le travail d'équipe et souhaite s'investir durablement. Si vous aimez relever des défis concrets et évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, innovant et porteur de sens, nous serons ravis de vous accueillir. »  
Vos missions clés  
Vous pilotez les projets d'installation et de modernisation des systèmes de contrôle d'accès électroniques et mécaniques, de l'analyse des besoins jusqu'à leur mise en service.  
Vous assurez la maintenance préventive et curative des installations, diagnostiquez les pannes et intervenez rapidement afin de garantir leur bon fonctionnement et leur conformité.  
Vous coordonnez les chantiers et les différents intervenants, en veillant au respect des délais, des normes de sécurité et de la qualité des réalisations.  
Vous gérez les aspects techniques et administratifs des installations, notamment la programmation des systèmes, le suivi des dossiers, la gestion des stocks et le contrôle des coûts.  
Vous conseillez et accompagnez les utilisateurs ainsi que les partenaires internes et externes, en apportant votre expertise technique et des solutions adaptées aux besoins du terrain.  
Vous contribuez à l'amélioration continue des installations et des procédures, en proposant des optimisations techniques et en participant à l'évolution des infrastructures de l'EVAM.  
Votre profil  
CFC dans le domaine de la serrurerie, de la construction métallique ou dans un métier technique jugé équivalent.  
Expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans le domaine du contrôle d'accès ou dans une fonction similaire.  
Expérience en coordination d'équipes, conduite de travaux ou suivi de chantiers.  
Excellente capacité à lire et interpréter des plans d'architecture et schémas techniques.  
Permis de conduire indispensable.  
Ce que l'EVAM vous propose  
Un environnement de travail engagé  
Une politique de formation continue pour évoluer dans votre carrière  
Une politique de télétravail  
5 semaines de vacances (6 dès 50 ans)  
De très bonnes prestations sociales  
Des projets porteurs de sens dans un contexte interculturel stimulant  
Le processus de recrutement en 3 étapes :

Une immersion dans l'équipe

title: Schichtleiter und Anlagen-Operator 100%  in Full-Reuenthal
description:
SELFRAG – Wir machen aus Abfall echte Wertstoffe.  
Bei der SELFRAG AG packen wir die Zukunft an. Mit unserer weltweit einzigartigen Technologie holen wir wertvolle Metalle und Mineralien aus Verbrennungsschlacke zurück, die sonst einfach auf der Deponie landen würden. Damit sparen wir tonnenweise CO2 und schützen unsere Umwelt.  
Heute betreiben wir unser Werk Centro Uno in Full\-Reuenthal – und aufgrund des grossen Erfolgs unseres Modells befindet sich unser zweites Werk, Centro Due, bereits im Bau. Wir sind ein motiviertes Team, das die Kreislaufwirtschaft nicht nur theoretisch bespricht, sondern jeden Tag in der Praxis umsetzt.  
Werde Teil unserer Truppe und unterstütze uns als Schichtleiter und Anlagenführer.  
Schichtleiter und Anlagen\-Operator 100% (m/w/d) in Full\-Reuenthal (CH)

Schichtführung: Du leitest die Schicht, koordinierst das Team und packst bei Bedarf überall mit an.  
Anlagensteuerung: Du bedienst und steuerst unsere moderne Aufbereitungsanlage direkt vor Ort und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Betrieb.  
Wartung \& Instandhaltung: Du führst Service\- und Unterhaltsarbeiten an der Anlage selbstständig durch, damit technisch alles einwandfrei läuft.  
Logistik: Du behältst den Überblick bei der Anlieferung und dem Abtransport und sorgst für das richtige Handling der gewonnenen Wertstoffe.  
Mitgestaltung: Als Pionier im ersten Werk gibst du deine praktischen Erfahrungen weiter, um unsere zukünftigen Standorte noch besser zu machen.  
Arbeitsmodell: Du arbeitest in einem 3\-Schicht\-Betrieb.  
Dein Profil  
Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung aus der Industrie mit, idealerweise aus den Bereichen Recycling, Kiesaufbereitung oder Produktion.  
Führungskompetenz: Die Führung der Mitarbeitenden innerhalb deiner Schicht ist für dich zentral; du bringst bereits entsprechende Führungserfahrung mit und kannst ein Team motivieren.  
Handwerk \& Technik: Du bist handwerklich geschickt und dein technisches Verständnis sowie dein sicheres Händchen für Maschinen zeichnen dich aus.  
Persönlichkeit: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, pflegst einen respektvollen Umgang und hast den Mut, Probleme offen und direkt anzusprechen.  
Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher und klar auf Deutsch.  
Was wir dir bieten  
Wir bieten dir einen krisensicheren Job mit Sinn in einem kollegialen Team. Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen – wenn es ein Problem gibt, lösen wir es unkompliziert. Du hast viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und arbeitest unter zeitgemässen Bedingungen an einer der modernsten Recycling\-Anlagen der Schweiz.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you'll be a hands\-on technical leader with company\-level impact across our Real Estate vertical. You’ll shape and evolve the frontend architecture powering our portals, create shared frontend solutions adopted by multiple teams, and orchestrate complex initiatives.  
Meet the team!

Yuliya Zvolskaya \- Engineering Manager \- LinkedIn  
At a high level, you will:  
Set technical direction for frontend across multiple teams, building alignment among engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders.

Defining and driving the culture of engineering excellence, while leading the evolution of our Real Estate frontend architecture to support future requirements, setting and improving SLAs/SLOs and anticipating ripple effects across systems together with other engineers and principals.  
Act as a trusted technical leader across teams and locations for frontend topics, shaping how web experiences are built across our organisation and influencing decisions at both team and leadership levels.  
Represent frontend engineering in cross\-functional and leadership discussions, helping the organisation make better long\-term technical trade\-offs.  
Design and create shared frontend libraries, components and tooling (e.g. design system, performance monitoring) that are widely used by internal teams, focusing on pragmatic, reusable solutions and driving their adoption.  
Orchestrate multi\-system refactors and migrations like framework upgrades, cross\-product harmonisation.  
Mentor and coach other engineers through structured mentorship, pairing, and feedback, helping them grow their skills and closing skill gaps you observe in the organisation by organising structured trainings for our people.  
Model a healthy feedback culture, helping people navigate tough conversations and conflicts in a constructive, blameless way.  
Challenge and improve team and cross\-team processes, suggesting changes that improve focus, quality, and speed when needed.  
You’ll still write plenty of code, but your impact will be measured just as much by how you multiply the effectiveness of others as by your individual output.  
Your day\-to\-day  
You'll be part of a product team, splitting time about half and half between product delivery and staff responsibilities, depending on the current needs and priorities  
Innovate, design, implement, and deploy frontend\-focused engineering solutions for our products, from discovery to production.  
Build alignment across teams with different goals and constraints, and unblock progress on ambiguous, cross\-cutting initiatives. Step in to create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership when needed.  
Own the end\-to\-end technical vision for key user journeys like Homegate and Immoscout24 and more, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, UX quality, and reliability  
Lead cross\-team frontend initiatives (for example: shared design system improvements, cross\-brand UI harmonisation, performance budgets, or observability patterns).  
Identify and surface cross\-cutting technical bottlenecks, such as performance drags in the core user journey or build\-time inefficiencies, and advocate for their resolution at the leadership level.  
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to shape technical strategy and trade\-offs for new features and platform work  
Partner with DevX to co\-develop engineering 'blueprints' and health scorecards, setting the gold standard for what 'good' looks like in our frontend repositories  
Evaluate, prototype, and introduce new frontend technologies and approaches (frameworks, tooling, patterns), document your findings, and drive adoption where they make sense  
Own and evolve the Frontend ADR process, ensuring technical decisions are documented, socialised, and consistently implemented across our organisation  
Guide and review the work of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, guild, and informal coaching.  
Help the team embrace and leverage AI \& large language models in our engineering workflows and products  
Contribute to and facilitate the frontend guild, tech chats, and other cross\-team knowledge\-sharing formats

title: Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy & Technology
description:
Shape the Future of Treasury. Lead with Innovation.

Treasury functions are undergoing a profound transformation. The convergence of advanced technology, artificial intelligence, and evolving financial landscapes is redefining how global organizations manage liquidity, mitigate risk, and drive strategic value. We're looking for an exceptional Senior Associate to help our clients navigate this transformation - someone who combines deep financial expertise with cutting-edge technology knowledge and a passion for innovation.

What You Can Expect From Us

- Strategic Advisory at the Highest Level: You will advise international corporations on complex treasury, financial risk management, and cash management challenges, with a specific focus on treasury technology, systems architecture, and digital transformation.
- Transformational Impact: You will help drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder transformation initiatives at global companies - reshaping how treasury functions operate, create value, and leverage technology.
- AI & Innovation Leadership: You will be at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to treasury and financial processes - from cash flow forecasting and liquidity optimization to fraud detection, risk modeling, and intelligent automation.
- Thought Leadership: You will provide thought leadership and practical, actionable advice on treasury strategy, financial risk management, regulatory compliance, and the evolving role of technology in finance.
- Efficiency & Value Creation: You will improve the added value, operational efficiency, internal controls, and regulatory compliance of clients' treasury functions and their supporting technology ecosystems.
- Collaborative Excellence: You will collaborate with a diverse, global network of highly talented experts across strategy, technology, risk, and finance - sharing knowledge and building innovative solutions together.
- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.

What We Expect From You

Experience & Qualifications
- 3 - 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.
- University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.

Technical & Domain Expertise
- Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).
- In-depth, hands-on knowledge of at least one leading Treasury Management System (TMS) such as FIS (Quantum/Integrity), Kyriba, Coupa Treasury, ION (IT2/Wallstreet Suite), SAP Treasury, or similar - including implementation, configuration, and optimization experience.
- Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.
- Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.
- Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.

Personal & Professional Attributes
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.
- Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C-suite executives and treasury leadership.
- An advisory and team-oriented mindset - you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.
- Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross-functional, international teams.
- Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus.
- A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.

Why This Role?
This is not just a consulting role - it's an opportunity to sit at the intersection of finance and technology during one of the most exciting periods of transformation in corporate treasury. You will work on challenges that matter, with people who inspire, for clients who are shaping the global economy.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)  
HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.  
Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen  
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)  
Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab  
Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.  
In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher  
Möchtest du ein DevOps\-Team von Grund auf mitgestalten und deine Erfahrungen einbringen? Suchst du ein stabiles Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden?  
Dann freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder auf deinen Anruf. jpid05677cfjm jit0833jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Researcher & Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80-100%
description:
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
Combine research and teaching at MSc level, and actively shape the future of midwifery science. In this role, you will strengthen evidence\-based care, promote knowledge transfer and contribute to the further development of a young academic profession.  
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
School:  
School of Health Professions  
Starting date:  
Immediately or by arrangement  
Your role  
In this role you will:  
Design, secure funding for, coordinate, contribute to and lead research and development projects in midwifery and sexual and reproductive health. You will liaise closely with the head of the research unit, take responsibility for project budgets and lead project teams.  
Help shape the strategic development of the research \& development unit and strengthen the internal and external knowledge transfer as well as the national and international visibility of the institute. This will be reflected in your interdisciplinary collaboration, scientific publications, conference presentations and accessible science communication.  
Take responsibility for modules within the MSc Midwifery programme. You will design, plan, deliver, evaluate and ensure the quality of profession\-specific and interprofessional modules. To that end, you will develop scientifically sound module objectives, teaching content, didactic formats and assessment methods at EQF level 7\.  
Teach classes in the MSc Midwifery programme and, where required, in the BSc Midwifery. You will systematically integrate the latest research findings, blended learning, e\-learning and the considered use of artificial intelligence into your teaching and learning environments.  
Provide expert guidance to students on their master's theses, develope and evaluate assessments, and conduct resit examinations in accordance with the applicable quality and AI guidelines.  
Support the programme director in the strategic, organisational, curricular and didactic development of the MSc Midwifery programme. You will contribute to the further development of module curricula, quality assurance and AI integration, and actively represent the programme within the professional community.  
Your profile  
You hold a PhD in midwifery, psychology, health sciences, social sciences or a related field. Your scientific expertise focuses on midwifery care and/or sexual and reproductive health.  
You have successfully developed, secured funding for, conducted and led research projects, and are experienced in project planning, coordination and implementation.  
You have proven expertise in quantitative research methods and confidently apply health or social science methods, with nuance and a strong commitment to quality.  
You have experience in higher education teaching, ideally at master's level, and have completed a continuing education qualification in higher education didactics or a comparable qualification.  
The following would be advantageous:  
A recognised midwifery qualification as well as a sound understanding of the field's professional practice and current challenges facing the profession.  
Several years of professional experience as a midwife or other relevant professional experience outside the higher education sector.  
Enthusiasm for creatively developing and implementing innovative research projects, teaching formats and sustainable solutions.  
Experience in inter\- and transdisciplinary collaboration, as well as the willingness to productively combine different profession\-specific and practice\-based perspectives.  
This is what we stand for  
Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  
The ZHAW School of Health Sciences is one of the largest and most renowned centres for education and continuing professional development for health professions in the German\-speaking countries. More than 2,000 students and 300 employees benefit from unique degree and continuing education programmes as well as attractive job opportunities in teaching and research in the heart of Winterthur (Canton of Zurich).  
The Midwifery Research Unit promotes quality in obstetrics and midwifery through applied research and development projects by focusing on the best possible care for women, children and families during pregnancy and childbirth, the postpartum period and breastfeeding. We train midwives as well as the next generation of researchers, and develop innovative, sustainable solutions to ensure the delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered and evidence\-based care by midwives and interprofessional teams. Another focus area is the promotion of sexual and reproductive health among the population.  
ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.  
What you can expect  
We offer working conditions and terms of employment commensurate with higher education institutions and actively promote personal development for staff in leadership and non\-leadership positions.
